readings: Link each income record to the member who brought it in and to that member's major, dropping any income that does not link up. For each college of those majors, show the college, the total income amount, and that total as a fraction of the combined income of all colleges (only income matched to a college), without rounding.
queries:
SELECT m2.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(i2.amount) FROM income i2 JOIN member mb2 ON i2.link_to_member = mb2.member_id JOIN major mj2 ON mb2.link_to_major = mj2.major_id) AS fraction
FROM income i
JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id
JOIN major m2 ON mb.link_to_major = m2.major_id
GROUP BY m2.college
